title: ai settings / Source control settings
content:
## Source control settings | Setting and Description | Default | |------------------------|---------------| | `setting(git.addAICoAuthor)`
Append a `Co-authored-by:` Git trailer to commit messages for AI-generated changes. Options: `off` (no trailer), `chatAndAgent` (trailer for Copilot Chat or agent mode changes), `all` (trailer for all AI-generated code, including inline completions). See [AI co-author attribution](/docs/sourcecontrol/staging-commits.md#ai-co-author-attribution). | `"off"` |
